Local copies of the site's front-end libraries so the course works offline.
Sources (cdn.jsdelivr.net): docsify 4.13.1 (core, vue theme, search), docsify-copy-code 2.1.1,
prismjs 1.30.0 (csharp, sql, yaml, json, bash, python, typescript), katex 0.16.9 (css, js, auto-render, fonts),
js-yaml 4.1.0, mermaid 10.9.8.
Google Fonts: fonts/fonts.css (Roboto Mono, Source Sans Pro, @imported by vue.css) and
fonts/trainer-path.css (JetBrains Mono, Source Sans 3, used by ai-native-trainer-path.html).
